About this course
This all levels music & instruments course offers 33.5 hours of instruction. By the end, you'll be able to learn proper posture, hand position, and technique; build core chords and strumming patterns; read chord charts and simple tablature; practice playing full songs at your level. Every course on TutorA is reviewed by our team before it's published, and every request is matched by a person — not an open marketplace where anyone can pitch you.
Structured to work for both newcomers and learners with prior experience in music & instruments.
